contracts.name: Crossdeck published spatial clue Player consumer

experience.persona: An authorized Player receiving a Creator-published spatial clue in a persisted private Voyage
experience.integrationOwner: Parallax published-clue delivery with Crossdeck continuity
experience.accessibility: Every named control is keyboard reachable with visible focus; reduced motion preserves the same task, hierarchy, purpose and safe return.
experience.fallback: Guided Lens preserves the released clue without camera permission; unavailable device purposes remain explained and disabled while Journal and safe return remain available.

references.reason: Accepted task hierarchy and contextual navigation inform the new device composition; the companion still requires its own independent rendered review.
references.preserve: Readable hierarchy, bounded controls, clear destinations and an equivalent constrained/mobile return.

continuity.objective: Keep the same authorized Voyage and immutable edition through connection, purpose changes and return without inventing progression authority.

motion.measurement: Keyboard activation to the changed visible connection or canonical companion outcome
motion.justification: Bound the isolated browser transition to useful visible feedback within five seconds, including authorized network projection and supported motion; this is no physical-device performance claim.

limitations: Canonical synthetic account/session setup proves authorization and persisted membership; it does not grant owner acceptance, camera/native spatial capability or real-phone proof.

Actual two-context pairing, handoff acknowledgement, revocation and restricted shared-display privacy remain covered by the dedicated browser specification; the single-context capture signs in and registers through the actual product UI.

This focused consumer contract delivers an already published synthetic Creator-authored clue. Creator Studio authoring and publication retain their existing qualification scope; no new authoring or native camera acceptance is claimed.

The existing generic seed owns only a deterministic synthetic account and persisted edition in a guarded nonce database; real sign-in, authorization and device registration establish each capture surface without injected cookies or tab storage.

The guarded persisted fixture represents an already-opened active Voyage. Every primary entry waits for visible Journal tools, and companion return proves the canonical returning Journal and its replay control rather than assuming a first-open dialog in each signed-in context.
experience.objective: Read and inspect the actual published spatial clue while keeping the same Voyage
experience.visibleOutcome: A released Creator-authored spatial moment opens its canonical Guided Lens, meaningful inspection and a direct return to the same published Voyage
experience.navigation: Open the active Journal, open its released Chronicle Lens, inspect the actual clue, then close Lens and return to the same Journal.
experience.designTarget: Preserve the published clue and readable Guided hierarchy, with truthful camera availability, keyboard inspection and an immediate contextual close/return.

journeys.outcome: The published spatial attachment reaches canonical Guided Lens, offers actual Inspect interaction and returns to the same authorized edition

steps.meaning: The canonical published spatial attachment presents its actual released clue without substituting a role label or service result.

contracts.name: Homeport readable Player account recovery after companion access ends

experience.persona: A signed-out Player returning to the canonical account task after a companion connection loses access
experience.objective: Read the Player account entry, use canonical sign-in and recovery, and safely return to the phone connection task
experience.visibleOutcome: Readable Player account instructions and links lead to one canonical account flow and a contextual return to the connection task
experience.accessibility: The parchment entry has readable explanation and recovery links; keyboard focus reaches every account and contextual return action without horizontal overflow.
experience.fallback: The existing canonical account flow remains usable without an identity provider; expired or revoked private companion content is not presented by this anonymous entry.
experience.navigation: Player account entry opens canonical sign-in; Forgot Password and Return to Sign In retain the safe return intent; Return to previous page restores the phone connection task.
experience.designTarget: Preserve the current parchment account ledger and its hierarchy, with material-appropriate ink, explicit account actions and a readable safe return.

references.reason: The accepted narrow task composition uses one visible objective and a clear recovery/return hierarchy.
references.preserve: Readable task-first typography, grouped fields, useful recovery links, intentional narrow-mobile layout.

references.reason: The accepted mobile account ledger keeps fields and recovery actions readable and reachable.
references.preserve: Readable task-first typography, grouped fields, useful recovery links, intentional narrow-mobile layout.

motion.measurement: Keyboard activation to the changed visible canonical sign-in, recovery or connection return
motion.justification: Bound visible account-route feedback in normal and reduced motion within five seconds, without claiming physical-device performance.

limitations: This anonymous recovery composition does not replace authenticated same-person/Voyage pairing, transfer or revocation proof in the Crossdeck contracts.
Live mail delivery, OAuth, physical phone, assistive technology and owner acceptance are not established by this browser journey.

journeys.outcome: A signed-out Player reaches canonical account recovery through readable controls and returns safely to the phone connection task

steps.meaning: The contextual Player entry opens the actual canonical account form
